# Business Requirement
We require an automated and standardized process to generate UPC (Universal Product Code) and GTIN (Global Trade Item Number) values for Walmart orders.
To support Walmart's compliance requirements, Shahi must ensure that valid and unique UPC/GTIN numbers are generated and associated with each applicable SKU.
These identifiers are used across various trims that are physically procured and applied to garments, including wash care labels, generic tags, size strips, RFID hangtags, and UPC stickers. Depending on the sourcing model, these trims are procured from approved vendors such as AD and RPAC,

# Purpose
This enhancement will:
• Auto Generation of unique UPC & GTIN

# Scope
This enhancement applies:
• Introduction of new menu UPC & GTIN Master
• Visibility of UPC & GTIN Master on style Techpack.
• Integration between WFX & Movex (M3) system for maintain unique

## Introduction of new menu as UPC & GTIN Configurator as Form Type
Company Setup >> Techpack Setting >> Techpack Form
After we enable this Form type same need to enable on Techpack master.
• The Techpack Forms displayed in any Techpack shall be managed through the Techpack Form Setting. This applies to both newly created Techpacks and existing Techpacks.
• If a Techpack Form is marked as Default in the Techpack Form Setting, the system shall automatically add that form when a new Techpack is created. Additionally, the Default Name configured for the form shall be displayed in the Techpack instead of the original Techpack Form name.
If user click on ‘UPC & GTIN Configurator’ on Techpack below screen need to visible: -
• Button-level permissions (Generate UPC / Generate Assortment UPC / Generate GTIN)
• Checkbox freeze after UPC generation
Once a Color/Size cell's checkbox is used to generate a UPC, that checkbox becomes disabled (greyed out, unchecked).
• Generate Assortment UPC popup logic
User enters a count N (e.g. 10) → system creates N synthetic "colors" named AS1...AS10, each carrying the full-size range as comma-separated values (S, M, L, XL, XXL).
• GTIN generation from generated UPC records
After UPC or Assortment UPC records exist in the "Generated UPC & GTIN Details" grid, user picks a Prefix (Store 30 / Online 20), selects rows via the row checkboxes, then clicks Generate GTIN — which populates the respective GTIN Store (30) or GTIN Online (20) column.
• GTIN freeze per prefix
If a row already has a GTIN Store (30) value, that row's checkbox becomes unselect able for further Store (30) generation — but presumably remains selectable for Online (20) if that column is still blank, and vice versa. This confirms Store/Online are tracked as independent completion flags per row, not a single "GTIN generated" flag.
• Form Type UPC & GTIN Configurator not able to delete from the Techpack master if there is any ‘Generated UPC’ or ‘Generated Assortment UPC’ record exist.
• UPC Number (Generate UPC & Generate Assortment UPC) Generation Logic
• First six character of UPC number are vendor code provided from Walmart to Shahi and it is fixed ‘887512’.
• Next five numbers are running sequence which started from 1 and now reached at 59000 in M3(Shahi Current System).
• Last digit calculations are mentioned below

[TABLE 2: Table 2 · 7 rows · columns: Step (integer), Description (text), Calculation (text), Result (integer)]
| Step | Description | Calculation | Result |
| 1 | Digit positions (11-digit code) | 8-8-7-5-1-2-5-3-8-0-4 (positions 1–11) | — |
| 2 | Sum of ODD position digits (1,3,5,7,9,11) | 8 + 7 + 1 + 5 + 8 + 4 | 33 |
| 3 | Multiply odd sum by 3 | 33 × 3 | 99 |
| 4 | Sum of EVEN position digits (2,4,6,8,10) | 8 + 5 + 2 + 3 + 0 | 18 |
| 5 | Add Step 3 + Step 4 | 99 + 18 | 117 |
| 6 | Take last digit of total | Last digit of 117 | 7 |
| 7 | Subtract from 10 to get check digit | 10 − 7 | 3 |
Final UPC Number: 887512538043 (original 11 digits + check digit 3)
• GTIN Number Generation Logic
• UPC Number: 887512538043
• Online Prefix (20): 2088751253804
• Last digit calculations are mentioned below

[TABLE 3: Table 3 · 7 rows · columns: Step (integer), Description (text), Calculation (text), Result (integer)]
| Step | Description | Calculation | Result |
| 1 | Digit positions (13-digit code) | 2-0-8-8-7-5-1-2-5-3-8-0-4 (positions 1–13) | — |
| 2 | Sum of ODD position digits (1,3,5,7,9,11,13) | 2 + 8 + 7 + 1 + 5 + 8 + 4 | 35 |
| 3 | Multiply odd sum by 3 | 35 × 3 | 105 |
| 4 | Sum of EVEN position digits (2,4,6,8,10,12) | 0 + 8 + 5 + 2 + 3 + 0 | 18 |
| 5 | Add Step 3 + Step 4 | 105 + 18 | 123 |
| 6 | Take last digit of total | Last digit of 123 | 3 |
| 7 | Subtract from 10 to get check digit | 10 − 3 | 7 |
Final GTIN Number: 20887512538047 (original 13 digits + check digit 7)

## Integration of UPC & GTIN in between Movex (M3) & WFX
• New style/article created in WFX.
• WFX → M3: outbound GET API call pulls/pushes the new style data to Movex (M3) — style code, color, size, article details
Parameters: -

[TABLE 4: Table 4 · 3 rows · columns: Parameter (text), Type (text), Required (boolean), Description (text)]
| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| Buyer | string | Yes | Buyer/customer name (e.g., "WALMART") |
| Created From | Date (DD-MM-YYYY) | Yes | Start of style creation date range |
| Created To | Date (DD-MM-YYYY) | Yes | End of style creation date range |
API Response: -
[
{
"styleCode": "SFC-001",
"styleName": "Slim Fit Chino",
"variants": [
{
"colorCode": "RD01",
"colorName": "Red",
"sizeCode": "S",
"sizeName": "Small",
"upcNumber": "887512538043",
"gtinDetails": [
{
"prefix": "30",
"prefixLabel": "Store",
"gtinNumber": "008881253804A"
},
{
"prefix": "20",
"prefixLabel": "Online",
"gtinNumber": "009981253804B"
}
]
},
{
"colorCode": "BL02",
"colorName": "Blue",
"sizeCode": "M",
"sizeName": "Medium",
"upcNumber": "887512538050",
"gtinDetails": [
{
"prefix": "30",
"prefixLabel": "Store",
"gtinNumber": "008881253805C"
},
{
"prefix": "20",
"prefixLabel": "Online",
"gtinNumber": "009981253805D"
}
]
}
]
}
]
• M3 generates the UPC & GTIN.
• M3 → WFX: M3 responds back via POST API, pushing the generated UPC/GTIN numbers into WFX against the corresponding style/color/size record.
Note: - In case of Assortment UPC in M3 system they pass any color code, color name, size code, size name and that can also possible that color code, color name, size code, size name not exist against that particular style so WFX system need to accept that record from M3 system.

# Acceptance Criteria:
• UPC & GTIN generation logics need to work as per the above-mentioned points.
